scene.notes: Pilot sofa has no opaque furniture part in front of legs in this frontal pose; separate scene occluders are required for chairs/tables that overlap actors. Walkable foot centers include a margin for actor width.

limitations: Pilot has four human size profiles and one dog, two static poses, two reusable hair shapes, two face presets per profile.
Outfit layers currently provide one sweatshirt-and-trousers cut per profile/pose plus independent color palettes; additional garment shapes are not yet produced.
Walking/running/sleep/play/homework cycles, infants and toddlers, additional body builds and countries are not ready.
Fatigue slider is demo-only; no live-stat thresholds approved.
Hair and sitting fits remain draft until visual approval of pilot.
Only one room has a navigation/seat metadata pilot; previous housing backgrounds are not automatically playable scenes.

dog.notes: User-requested larger dog; same paw contact plane in both poses.

review.note: Owner confirmed all dogs and the small-breed scale.

humanLighting.policy: Neutral local material shading only; never add electric blue rim light to people.
